evidence: Row 48 is a static semantic review of all five prompts, their shared app_context and every injected criterion. Paths below are relative to the frozen task unless stated otherwise. instruction.md:1 asks for a local browser playground with no accounts; environment/instructions/overview.md:3-9 defines editor/preview/console, filename dispatch, app-provided examples and a shared library. tests/app_context.md:3-12 accurately supplies the Colderwater name, localhost:3000 URL, no-sign-in account model and the same workspace/control surfaces. The seed identifies Colderwater Playground and contains no supplied snippets. Render prompt.md:14-18 and constraints prompt.md:15-22 explicitly replace the template sign-in assumptions with public authored execution and shared-snippet storage; functional prompt.md:19 expressly excludes sign-in/account/tenant probes. Polish prompt.md:21 and visual prompt.md:42 likewise state no sign-in. No credential list, foreign product, private tenant, or unrelated mandatory screen remains. The detailed functional protocols use this app's .js/.html/.css sources, console, last-good preview, five-second shared callback budget, saved title/filename/source/revision, conflicts and process restart: functional prompt.md:115-487 agrees with behaviour.md:5-29, security.md:3-11 and integration.md:5-13. The declared 23 protocols at functional prompt.md:9 match the 23 actual S headings. Polish prompt.md:43-51 tours the controls required by ui.md:7-9; visual prompt.md:44-46 assesses playground chrome, both themes and responsive surfaces, not arbitrary snippet artwork. Its alternative panel/drawer/page language agrees with public layout freedom. Generic references to imported/exported product data (functional:7) and uploads as an action-count example (functional:102) impose no import/export feature or probe. Conforming-alternative and weak-app counterfactuals found no prompt-identity mismatch (see counterexample). All five prompt files contain exactly one app_context and one criteria placeholder. Manual hash verification matched all 50 frozen task files and 34 frozen rule/template files against manifest.json. The current raw-evidence index matched the assigned input hash; SHA256 a6ec924aa6d761bf6535c59ffc5f99e1845e336acca876aae3583b25c71fd392, and all 426 listed artifact hashes matched. No runtime result is needed to establish this textual row, and none is inferred: full configured judge workload/completion, Oracle grade, Luna score, empirical configured reward ranking/floor and completed isolation review remain explicitly unmeasured in that index. This Pass does not clear those separate requirements or establish a private-checker/portal pass.
counterexample: Source-level counterfactuals, not executed runs: a sibling-style account dashboard or a static playground could not satisfy Render's no-sign-in authored DOM/console run (gates/render/judge.toml:23-27); a localStorage-only snippet library could not satisfy independent-clean-context server retrieval (gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29).
